news.title: University of Illinois College of Medicine earns continued full nine-year accreditation
news.summary_en: The Liaison Committee on Medical Education votes to continue the college’s full accreditation after extensive self-study and survey visit.

news.title: New scholarship from retired professor will support interns at Field Museum
news.summary_en: The funding will provide an internship stipend to a student intern starting this spring.

news.title: UIC research: Treating cancer pain with acupuncture
news.summary_en: A new UIC study examines how breast cancer survivors respond to the therapy.
